checks.message: Provisional boundary has official_boundary=false and provisional_constraint labels in geometry, proposal, sources, assumptions and visual page.
Shared-cut partition is designed to cover the submitted boundary without gaps or overlaps; spatial review recomputes this.
Known areas and ratios are recalculated from submitted GeoJSON in EPSG:4548; unknown controls remain null.
Visualization is a static local HTML package with no CDN, remote media or network requests.
Formal, background and provisional materials are distinguished; context sources are not upgraded to formal planning evidence.
